name: 17484-decodeheavy-dsv2lite-1gpu
hardware: 1x NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1), SM90.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, EP off. One in-process vLLM engine, one process, no NCCL.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams 4 then 8 then 32 as three benchmarks in one run, each bounded at 96 requests with a 900 s safety cap, warmup the first 25% by completion, so 72 requests are counted at each point.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix_buckets, greedy: prompt exactly 1000 tokens and output exactly 2000 (min = max on both). The backend forces ignore_eos=True whenever max_tokens is set, so all 2000 tokens are generated; the chat template and add_special_tokens put the engine's own prompt count a few tokens above 1000.
purpose: A long-form drafting assistant generating 2000-token answers from 1000-token prompts for 4 to 32 concurrent users on one GPU.
launch:
# ENGINE: commit afb12e42948d50c85ffa9deb9963edda5814bffa (`v0.8.4-420-gafb12e42948d5`).
#
# CAUTION, flat reader: any line starting with a space is skipped, so every key must be
# top-level and every value must fit on one line, or the key never reaches the engine.

model: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V2-Lite-Chat

# Required, not decorative: `deepseek_v2` is not a model_type the pinned transformers
# knows, so AutoConfig cannot load this repo's config without it.
trust-remote-code: true

tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16
max-model-len: 16384
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
max-num-seqs: 1024
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
